project_type: Python backend (stdlib http.server) + vanilla JS/HTML/CSS frontend - PV simulator
build_system: None - pure Python stdlib, no build step
verification_instructions: 1. Run unit tests. 2. Start server with python3 backend/main.py. 3. Test endpoints with curl.
setup_instructions: python3 backend/main.py starts server on port 8000
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET - full network access. Python 3.9+ available.
contribution_requirements: Tests must pass (400 tests currently passing). Polish language in UI.
key_patterns: Backend: services/ has calculation modules, api/handlers.py routes requests. Frontend: Solar Pro dark theme (CSS variables in style.css), amber/gold accent colors, glassmorphism cards. report.html uses dark theme correctly. energy-profile.html has WRONG light theme.
directory_structure: backend/ (main.py, api/, services/, models/, data/, tests/), frontend/ (index.html, viewer.html, pages/, css/, js/)
